item: A2 — teach session API: cited clauses, the expert's rule, 2-5 labelled examples

hardware.NOT_the_published_bench_machine: V02_REPORT.md and BASELINES.md figures were measured on 2 vCPU Xeon (AVX-512) / 8 GB. Nothing here may be merged with those.

acceptance_criterion: `syntriass teach start --doc <file> --page <n>` creates a session holding cited clauses, the expert's plain-language rule and 2-5 labelled examples with reasons, persisted under the tenant at mode 0600

binary.model_calls_note: A teach session records an expert's words against a document's bytes. No model is loaded and none is reachable: the config's model fields are UNUSED_BY_TEACH and nothing in this run opens a socket. This is a property of the item, not an untested claim.

ocr_session.why_it_matters: Every clause on page 20 came from OCR, so every value in them is a hypothesis to put back to the expert in B1, not a reading to assert. The session says so in a field rather than leaving it to whoever reads the clause text.

independent_hash_check.method: The canonical encoding was reproduced in Python from the stored file (research/capability-learning/harness/record_teach_session.py:canonical) and hashed with hashlib, with no Rust code involved.

refusals.note: Each entry is the stderr of a real attempt that exited non-zero. Nothing here is a description of what the code would do.
